THE TEST

You have invited your two nephews aged 9 and 10 years for a weekend lunch. Using the ingredients
listed below, prepare, cook and serve a one course meal for them. Include a nutritious drink.

Ingredients:

—  Rice/potatoes

— Cooking oil

— Salt

- Sugar

—  Beef/peas

- Carrots

~ Tomatoes

—  Cabbage/green leafy vegetables
— Onions

~  Dhania

— Green pepper

- Fruits in season.

PLANNING SESSION - 30 minutes

For each task listed below, use separate sheets of paper and a carbon paper to make duplicate copies
then proceed as follows:

1 Identify the dishes and write their recipes
2. Write your order of work

a Make a list of the foodstuff and equipment you will require.
